veranderings.na: brood, en hulle speel nog bordspeletjies
veranderings.rede: In the original, 'hulle' can be read as 'their' (families play their board games) and 'elke dag' seems to cover the games too; a separate clause with its own subject fixes both and takes the AWS comma before 'en'.

The sentence compares a farmer's 'gesin' (household) with a rich 'familie' (extended family); 'gesin' on both sides makes the comparison parallel (the block heading would then still say 'familie', so the reviewer may prefer to leave this).
